consent.title: Google Play Games Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating your Google Play Games data to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into gaming behaviors and platform usage.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please follow the download instructions and choose the Google Takeout file that you stored on your device.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments.
upload.noDataFound: No Google Play Games Data Found
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, corrupted, or void of Google Play Games data.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Google Play Games data in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The file is not a Google Takeout export
The file does not contain Google Play Games Services data
The file is corrupted or incomplete
The file contains no actual playtime data
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded the correct Google Takeout file or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take several seconds depending on the data size.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
